section_summary.extract_value: This section presents path analysis results from a structural equation model examining relationships between self-compassionate engagement, experiential avoidance/psychological inflexibility, self-compassionate action, and body appreciation. The readjusted model (after removing three non-significant paths) explained 21% of variance in experiential avoidance, 58% in self-compassionate action, and 34% in body appreciation, with all remaining paths showing statistical significance (p < .05). BMI showed a significant negative direct effect on body appreciation (β = -0.28, p < .001).
